summary: NFT Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering a best-efforts offering of 600,000 units at $1.00 per unit, each unit comprising one Class A ordinary share and one five-year common warrant struck at $1.00, plus 400,000 pre-funded units priced at $1.00 less $0.04 for buyers hitting the 4.99%/9.99% beneficial ownership cap. Roughly 1.4 million Class A shares underlie the warrants. Shares trade on NYSE American under MI, last at $0.8937 on October 8, 2026. This is a routine equity shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
